title: Tic tac toe winner
statementMd:
Players X and O alternate (X first) placing on a 3x3 board; `moves` is a list of `[row, col]`. Return `"X"` or `"O"` if someone has three in a row, `"Draw"` if the board is full with no winner, otherwise `"Pending"`.

**Example:** `tictactoe_winner([[0, 0], [2, 0], [1, 1], [2, 1], [2, 2]])` returns `"X"`.
